finalText:
Green: 625 passing, 0 failing.

One real bug, in `orderTotal` (`src/pricing.js:39`). It applied tax to the **pre-discount** base and added that to the discounted subtotal, contradicting its own doc comment. Only 3 of 625 cases had both a non-zero discount and non-zero tax, so it was invisible everywhere else.

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

E.g. 12000c at 15% off with 8.25% tax: was 11190, now 11042.
